nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category. The other respiratory viruses we monitor (RSV, Influenza A, Influenza B, HMPV and EV-D68) are in the ‘Low’ category nationwide and not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/Bf8KtOk2Ww

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category with medium concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/qBjgpi9ZwU

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, the LP.8.1 variant (a descendant of KP.1) in brown (68.5%) and other KP.1 variants in light green (25.6%) make up around 94% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/hiGxU597rx

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A and Flu B are in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. About 14% and 39% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/dXv4fVrXv3

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 27 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 8 in the South, and 6 in the Northeast. As of 5/7/25, 17 states have also reported infected cattle herds. Recent wastewater detections have been in CA, NC and NJ. https://t.co/jauZPeqVvR

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. About 14% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/Jq458Rp5xJ

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally because it is not in onset. 48.5% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV, which is near the national onset threshold. https://t.co/FXYKOhdlCw
